title: Premium share of bookings
statementMd:
What percentage of bookings are business or first class (rounded to 1 decimal)?

Expected columns: `premium_pct`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN seat_class <> 'economy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS premium_pct FROM bookings;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
